title: Agent record (/var/lib/shipshape/agents.json, version 1)
description: ShipShape's own record of the Claude agents a Ship keeps running: written only by ship-ctl (root), read by ship-ctl. It, not the runtime, decides which agents resume after a boot and which start again after a crash, so the runtime underneath (herdr's server today) can change without losing them. See contracts/ship-ctl.md, "The agent record". FleetLedger sees it through the status document's agent_record block, never this file.

runtime.description: What runs the agents: herdr (its server, 0.9).

agents.description: Keyed by the agent's name, which is also its name in the runtime.

primary.description: The agent marked as the Ship's primary (`ship-ctl agent primary NAME`), the one woken after a boot; at most one. null or absent: none is marked, and the first [[autostart]] agent recorded as running is the primary.

resume.description: This Ship's last resume after a boot: written once per boot, when every recorded agent has been started once.

cwd.description: Its working folder; claude --resume finds the session from here.

session.description: The Claude session id it runs, continued with claude --resume.

mode.description: The permission mode it runs in, and is resumed in. Follows the mode ledger.

prompt.description: The first prompt autostart gave it (sent again by a fresh restart).

session_name.description: The name it was launched with (claude --name).

origin.description: autostart: started by ship-ctl autostart. adopted: started some other way and picked up from the runtime.

want.description: running: resumed at boot, started again when it dies. stopped: it was exited on purpose (an adopted agent leaves the record instead).

place.description: Where it last ran: opaque to everything but the runtime adapter (herdr: its pane id).

boot_id.description: The boot it was seen there in.

relaunch.description: Failed tries in one boot: a start that failed, or an agent that stopped within 10 minutes of starting. The crash policy gives up after 3; they reset once the agent has run 10 minutes.

counted_launch.description: Set (to that start's launched_at) once the current start's early stop has been counted as a failed try; cleared by every start.

launched_at.description: When ship-ctl last started it, or picked it up.

permissionMode.description: Claude Code permission modes; "default" is the mode Claude Code calls Manual.

timestamp.description: UTC, RFC 3339, with a Z suffix.
